primary_metric: App whole-account daily NAV Sharpe Rf=0; mechanically common full available history with current six product comparators
primary_threshold: strictly exceed maximum full-history Rf=0 Sharpe among all six current product strategies, with all accounts on the same exact common observed valuation dates
secondary: report native full histories, since2020, since2022, trailing10Y and crisis2008/2020/2022; no weighted average selection
evaluation_end: 2026-10-06 (min latest observed gold/Nasdaq dates from frozen response; no moving date after returns)
evaluation_start: mechanical maximum first daily-state date across all current product controls and candidate accounts; no return-based start selection
sigma: population standard deviation of 20 observed CNY closes including signal date

rule_semantics.lower-downcross: previous close > previous lower, current <= lower: enter; cross above middle: exit
rule_semantics.lower-reentry: previous close <= previous lower, current > lower: enter; cross above middle: exit; if entry already exceeds middle, stay flat
rule_semantics.upper-breakout: previous close < previous upper, current >= upper: enter; cross below middle: exit

holdings: 100% single-asset target or RMB cash; no short/leverage/financing; retain latest known target
clock: strict T-1 observed close; next actual observed close; FX follows unchanged current App conversion
warmup: 252 aligned observations before starting, signals from asset own observed CNY price series, flat until simulator start
controls: all six current product strategies via unchanged BacktestCoreEngine rotation runtime
falsification: entry/exit hand vectors; future-truncation/perturbation invariance; all desired vs accepted targets and fills audited; no parameter or cost rescue after viewing results
multiple_testing: all six recorded; existing indicator history exposed; neither complete historical trial count nor independent holdout certified
limitations: Gold COMEX-derived CNY price proxy and Nasdaq price index are not independently verified physical gold or ETF funded total-return accounts.
Rf0 cash-only Sharpe is reported as diagnostic and cannot qualify as indicator alpha.
Native current product controls replay continuously from earliest observations. Comparison is on common continuous-history daily NAV, not new funded 2008 accounts.
No untouched OOS, no G0-G6 certification, no product promotion from D0.
